items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: he used to do duos with Anthony Braxton

ctx.x: And what sounds acceptable to the person playing it may be different from with an audience person hears.

That is true. Sometimes the musician is like zeroing in maybe with another improviser together on some very specific strange little molecular grainy sound and you’re like, “Oh I like that” and you just want to stay there. Like zeroing in like the microscope. And certain listeners would be like, “Wow, oh that’s so great.” But other people are like, “Oh my God they’re playing the same weird little sound. But that’s just the nature of the beast. I don't know if you know the great British improviser Evan Parker. He…
You know Roscoe Mitchell, who I had a session with –
